user_saw: The Gateway froze for about two seconds when plugin preparation created capture directories on a btrfs filesystem waiting for a transaction commit.
summary: Moved creation and custody of plugin source/native capture roots and staging tokens from the Gateway main thread into the existing broker resource owner.
reasoning: The synchronous capture-root creation on the main thread was a long-standing design (the parent allocation callback already existed before the blame candidates, e.g. dfb91dc29046 only moved worker-side root bookkeeping), and it is normally fast; it stalled only when the host filesystem (btrfs) blocked in wait_current_trans during a Team incident. No commit made this path slower, so it is environment-exposed latent behavior rather than a regression; the PR accepts higher total cost to keep the event loop free.
